resume.meaning: reconstruct repository authority and immediate health

prove.meaning: attempt to falsify the current change with cheap checks before runtime checks

harden.meaning: preserve state, then establish full project verification

recover.meaning: capture authority and a non-destructive recovery checkpoint

probe.meaning: run a bounded runtime health probe

mature.meaning: preserve, verify, then bounded local-agent play

handoff.meaning: establish auditable state before creating a handoff

learn.meaning: mine historical work, suggest vocabulary, benchmark generalization, and self-test Indro

orient.meaning: establish repository authority before deeper work

measure.meaning: benchmark both evidence mining and language-level generalization
